# HumanLink

HumanLink is an AI-powered human connection platform for people who need help and people who can help.

## Mission
Helping Humanity, One Connection at a Time.

## What HumanLink does
- Help people request and offer help
- Connect users with volunteers and NGOs
- Help students discover and share skills
- Help professionals showcase services and expertise
- Help businesses promote their services
- Help HR teams publish job opportunities
- Support community groups, messaging, reviews and reputation
- Provide HUMI AI assistance for clearer, safer requests

## Audience
Students, volunteers, job seekers, HR teams, teachers, professionals, NGOs, businesses and community members.

## Pricing
Community access is free. Paid plans are available for professional and organizational features. See the live pricing page for current plans and terms.

## Safety
HumanLink is a connection platform. Users should use appropriate caution, verify information independently and follow the community guidelines. HumanLink does not guarantee outcomes or the identity, qualifications or conduct of every user.
